description: Horizontal strip of a top-down pixel art fantasy world map: a remote polar snowfield above a glacier. Soft smooth white and pale blue shading exactly like the reference glacier - NO dark outlines, no cracked-ice line pattern. Wind-streaked snow drifts, the soft edge of a glacier shelf, and one small frost-covered rock outcrop. Mostly empty calm snow. No text, no borders.

reference_images.usage: below: the glacier and snowy forest immediately south of this strip; continue it northward with the same soft shading
